decisive_items: fungating, tender, 9 × 7 cm mass prone to bleeding
response.rationale: The long history of a stable scalp mass that recurred after excision and then metastasized to cervical lymph nodes and vertebrae strongly favors squamous cell carcinoma, which is known to arise in chronic lesions and metastasize. DFSP rarely metastasizes, and angiosarcoma is less consistent with the indolent onset.

rejected.why: DFSP is typically low-grade with a very low metastatic potential; the presence of vertebral metastases makes this diagnosis unlikely.
Angiosarcoma can present as a bleeding, fungating mass, but the 10-year stable course and metastatic pattern are more typical of squamous cell carcinoma.
